summary: Completed comprehensive testing of FortexaRH 'Pay First, Register After' checkout flow. All 17 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified - Landing page pricing section, Checkout page with price calculation, Register page with payment verification, and Subscriptions page all working correctly. Stripe integration is functional in test mode.
critical_code_review_comments: Public checkout endpoint /api/public/checkout correctly creates Stripe sessions without authentication
Checkout verification endpoint /api/public/checkout/verify/{session_id} properly validates payment status

Price calculation is correct: Basic $5+$1.50/emp, Pro $10+$1.50/emp, Enterprise $20+$1.50/emp
Trial plan correctly rejected for checkout (only paid plans allowed)
seed_data_creation: Created test users with TEST_ prefix during registration tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Checkout flow fully tested. Key endpoints verified: 1) POST /api/public/checkout - Creates Stripe checkout session (no auth required), returns checkout_url and session_id, 2) GET /api/public/checkout/verify/{session_id} - Verifies payment status (no auth required), 3) POST /api/auth/register with payment_session_id - Creates account with active subscription after payment, 4) POST /api/checkout - Authenticated checkout for existing users, 5) GET /api/checkout/status/{session_id} - Check payment status for authenticated users. UI verified: Landing page pricing buttons redirect to /checkout?plan=X, Checkout page shows plan details and calculates price correctly, Register page shows payment verification badge when session_id present.
